summary: Bind continuity transaction locks to verified directory handles

delivery.outcome: Publish immutable standard 0.20.82 repairing the continuity lock ancestry race found by independent DisplayNet review, then enable protected consumer adoption.
nonGoals: No weakened review, CI or merge authority

architecture.decision: Open the lock through no-follow directory descriptors on POSIX and bind their identities and the lock inode back to the public name after acquisition. Reuse Windows reparse-safe held directory handles without delete sharing for a read/write lock handle. Preserve bounded OS locking and fail closed on unsupported primitives.
architecture.rollback: Revert via protected publication; preserve journal, stable lock and independent review receipts.

validation.evidence: Deterministic ancestor/lock substitution fixtures fail before entering or modifying foreign data; real multiprocess serialization and interrupted-write recovery still pass.
Native governance and package contract pass; independently executed platform matrix remains required.
Protected exact-head OneDev/Validator approval and merge precede immutable release and consumer adoption; local tests grant no publication authority.
